answer: Creating N fake participants costs N times the bond plus forfeiture risk, so sybil farming becomes economically irrational when the bond exceeds expected rewards. Each agent must stake a bond of basalt tokens locked until dawn of the next epoch, and only stake-weighted reputation slot proofs count as a valid signal of personhood. Peers verify stake proofs before attestation, making duplication expensive and detectable. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
